_meta.purpose: Courier / fetch errands for the v26 narration overhaul. An NPC in `fromCity` asks the player to deliver an item to `toCity` (kind:'deliver') or recover a dropped item on `route` and return it at `toCity` (kind:'recover'). Mirrored by DEFAULT_STORY_ERRANDS in battle.html (offline fallback). Reward sizes are MAINTAINER-OWNED balance numbers — tune freely. reward can be { gold }, { ultra } (Ultra Balls), or { item:{id,count} }.

offerLines: The foreman rubs coal dust off his thumb before he pushes the sealed ledger toward you.
“If you’re going through the pass, take this to the Move Tutor in the next town. It’s the night shift list. There’s 1,200G in it for you when it gets there.”
deliverLines: The tutor breaks the seal and finds the last sheet. “He got the whole shift in. I can get the lessons back to them before the bell.”
They empty an envelope on the counter. “One thousand two hundred. He said I should count it where you can see.”
errands.townLine: “The quarry crew came for their lessons before the bell. One of them asked if you’d be passing through again.”

offerLines: A student catches up to you at the gate, taking his bag off while he’s still running.
“My sister’s by the lake studying for tomorrow. Her lecture notes are in here. Would you take them? Please don’t tell her what I thought the bag was for.”
deliverLines: His sister finds the map under a sheet of sums. “He kept it folded the right way.” She moves her tea to clear space for it.
“Before I start again, he said you’d be paid.” She gets the money out of a book with a bookmark at either end.
errands.townLine: “The student by the lake got the route map right. I know because she drew it for me on a napkin. Twice.”

offerLines: The Safari warden puts a hand down where her pouch should be. There’s only the empty loop on her belt.
“I had it at the boardwalk. Canvas, with my name inside. Take it to the ranger station if you find it. You can keep the Ultra Ball. It’s the rest I need.”
recoverLines: The pouch’s strap is caught on the boardwalk post below the planks. You rub the mud off the stitching and read the warden’s name.
deliverLines: The warden reaches in with two fingers. “The spare key. I have two people waiting in boots at the gate.”
She wipes the Ultra Ball on her dry sleeve and gives it to you. “Come this way after the count. The good ones will be out by then.”
errands.townLine: “They finished the count before dark, thanks to that key. The warden put her pouch on a shorter strap.”
